examples: Start the day by seeing every agent that is working, stopped or waiting on you, on one page.
Compare model token usage and estimated project cost over the same week without retaining any prompts.
how_to: Scan the stat tiles (one figure each), then running sessions, recently closed, projects, skills, themes and the provider ledger.
Click a running session to open it; use + to start one.

Read token/cache breakdowns, API-equivalent cost, activity, model/project rankings, tokens per agent (a line per agent over 1h, 24h or 1w, with the running agents and their tokens per minute below) and account/window quota history on Home. Open Details for filters, tables, annotations and comparisons. Edit layout to configure or hide cards; existing arrangements are preserved.

Every widget wears one 31px header: its icon menu at the left, its name, its own controls, then a close x that hides it at once (back from the components list; a copy such as a browser is removed). Untick show header in the icon menu to hide one copy's header on every device; its icon then sits over the top left of the widget.
name: Home screen
summary: See running sessions, projects, and independently configurable charts backed by metadata-only minute history.
where: The first screen after you sign in.
The Carnivore logo at the top of the drawer always returns to it.
media_exempt: screenshots and captures are not part of the open source export
